params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Rage Gene:}} {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} generates ''Rage'' while fighting. At maximum ''Rage'', his next {{tip|ability}} will be ''{{cis|Mega Gnar}}'' as he transforms, losing ''Mini Gnar's'' passive effects in exchange for increased stats and new abilities.
params.blurb2: ''Mega Gnar'' form lasts for some time before reverting to ''Mini Gnar'', afterwards he cannot generate ''Rage'' for some time.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Rage Gene:}} {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} generates {{pp|4;7;11|1 to 11}} ''{{ai|Rage Gene|Gnar|Rage}}'' over 2 seconds upon dealing or receiving damage, up to 100. Against non-champions, {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' instantly generate{{ft|{{pp|4*0.125;7*0.125;11*0.125|1 to 11|round=false}} ''Rage''.|{{fd|12.5%}} of the amount.}} Against champions, ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' instantly generates{{ft|{{pp|4*0.25;7*0.25;11*0.25|1 to 11|round=false}} ''Rage'',|25% of the amount,}}and basic attacks ''on-hit'' instantly generate{{ft|{{pp|4*0.5;7*0.5;11*0.5|1 to 11|round=false}}.|50% of the amount.}}''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}}'' can only generate ''Rage'' once per cast, and grants ''Rage'' based on the first enemy hit. '''Gnar's''' ''Rage'' decays after being [[combat status|out of combat]] for 13 seconds.
params.description2: At maximum ''Rage'', '''Gnar's''' {{tip|abilities}} switch to {{cis|Mega Gnar}} abilities, for 4 seconds and until transforming back to his ''Mini Gnar'' form, with the exception of ''{{ai|Hop and Crunch|Gnar|Hop}}'', which switches after the transformation. Casting any of them during this time also causes '''Gnar''' to transform into {{ci|Mega Gnar}} instantly, else he will transform automatically after the 4 seconds have elapsed.
params.description3: '''Gnar's''' {{ci|Mega Gnar|Mega}} form lasts for 15 seconds, with his ''Rage'' bar depleting as an indication of remaining time. ''Rage cannot be generated while in this form.'' Afterwards, '''Gnar''' returns to {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}}, retaining his {{sti|health|{{as|'''current''' percentage health}}}} and becoming too [[File:Rage Gene 4.png|20px]] ''tired'' to generate ''Rage'' for 15 seconds.
params.description4: '''Gnar''' gains different stat bonuses based on whether he is in ''{{ai|Mini Gnar|Gnar|Mini}}'' or ''{{ai|Mega Gnar|Gnar|Mega}}'' form. Both of '''Gnar's''' forms share their ability cooldowns.
params.notes: * The ''Rage'' generated upon dealing or receiving damage occurs over 2 seconds with 4 ticks every {{fd|0.5}} seconds. It also does not stack but instead refreshes with subsequent applications (of dealing or receiving damage). * In-game, the value on the ''Rage'' bar always displays rounded down to the nearest integer. * {{cis|Mega Gnar}} gained health is not affected by {{tip|healing}} modifiers such as {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} and those from [[item]]s and [[rune]]s. * When returning to {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}}, '''Gnar''' will only retain his current health percentage, not current health total. * '''Gnar's''' abilities share {{sti|cooldowns}} across forms. * The ''Rage'' bar is '''white''' when under 60 range, '''yellow''' when equal to or above 60 rage, and '''red''' at 100 rage. * If '''Gnar''' transforms into {{ci|Mega Gnar}} while on enemy's sight and later goes back to {{ai|Mini Gnar|Gnar|Mini}} while on the fog of war, enemies will see {{cis|Mega Gnar}} icon both in the scoreboard and minimap, even if they regain vision of '''Gnar'''. This will stay this way until '''Gnar's''' {{ci|Mega Gnar|Mega}} form ends while on enemy's sight.{{bug}}

blurb.plain: Innate - Rage Gene: Mini Gnar generates Rage while fighting. At maximum Rage, his next ability will be Mega Gnar as he transforms, losing Mini Gnar's passive effects in exchange for increased stats and new abilities.

blurb2.plain: Mega Gnar form lasts for some time before reverting to Mini Gnar, afterwards he cannot generate Rage for some time.

description.plain: Innate - Rage Gene: Mini Gnar generates 4 / 7 / 11 (based on level) Rage over 2 seconds upon dealing or receiving damage, up to 100. Against non-champions, basic attacks on-hit and Boomerang Throw instantly generate 0.5 / 0.875 / 1.375 (based on level) Rage. Against champions, Boomerang Throw instantly generates 1 / 1.75 / 2.75 (based on level) Rage, and basic attacks on-hit instantly generate 2 / 3.5 / 5.5 (based on level). Boomerang Throw can only generate Rage once per cast, and grants Rage based on the first enemy hit. Gnar's Rage decays after being out of combat for 13 seconds.

description2.plain: At maximum Rage, Gnar's abilities switch to Mega Gnar abilities, for 4 seconds and until transforming back to his Mini Gnar form, with the exception of Hop, which switches after the transformation. Casting any of them during this time also causes Gnar to transform into Mega Gnar instantly, else he will transform automatically after the 4 seconds have elapsed.

description3.plain: Gnar's Mega form lasts for 15 seconds, with his Rage bar depleting as an indication of remaining time. Rage cannot be generated while in this form. Afterwards, Gnar returns to Mini Gnar, retaining his current percentage health and becoming too tired to generate Rage for 15 seconds.

description4.plain: Gnar gains different stat bonuses based on whether he is in Mini or Mega form. Both of Gnar's forms share their ability cooldowns.

params.blurb2: '''Gnar''' can catch the boomerang, which {{sti|cdr|reduces}} the cooldown.

{{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' throws a boomerang in a line in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies in its path and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds.

After reaching its maximum range or hitting an enemy, the boomerang flies back toward '''Gnar''' based on his current movement, dealing 50% damage to subsequent targets.

blurb2.plain: Gnar can catch the boomerang, which reduces the cooldown.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Mega Gnar}} throws a boulder in the target direction that stops upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
params.blurb2: '''Mega Gnar''' can retrieve the boulder, which {{sti|ah|reduces}} the cooldown.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' throws a boulder in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon impact and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. The boulder then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.
params.description2: After {{fd|0.3}} seconds, '''Gnar''' can pick up the boulder by moving within 90 units of it, refunding 70% of the ability's {{sti|cooldown|'''total''' cooldown}}.

blurb.plain: Active: Mega Gnar throws a boulder in the target direction that stops upon the first enemy hit, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies slowing them.

blurb2.plain: Mega Gnar can retrieve the boulder, which reduces the cooldown.

description.plain: Active: Gnar throws a boulder in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies upon impact and slowing them for 2 seconds. The boulder then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.

description2.plain: After 0.3 seconds, Gnar can pick up the boulder by moving within 90 units of it, refunding 70% of the ability's total cooldown.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar's}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply {{tip|stacks}}. The third stack deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''maximum''' health}}, and grants a burst of {{sti|ms|{{as|movement speed}}}} to '''Gnar'''.
params.blurb2: '''Gnar''' will gain the {{as|movement speed}} upon {{ai|Rage Gene|Gnar|transforming}} back to {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Gnar's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Hyper'' to enemies for {{fd|3.5}} seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
params.description2: The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}, and grant '''Gnar''' {{pp|type = [[File:GNAR!.png|20px|border]] ''GNAR!'s'' rank|key=%|20 to 80 for 4|0 to 3|formula = 20% + 20% per GNAR!'s rank|color=ms}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 3 seconds.
params.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|0 to 40}} {{as|(+ {{ap|6 to 14}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}}}
params.description3: '''Gnar''' gains ''Hyper's'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} when he leaves {{ci|Mega Gnar|Mega}} form.
params.notes: * The bonus movement speed's duration refreshes whenever '''Gnar''' would receive it (by hitting a target three times again).

blurb.plain: Passive: Mini Gnar's basic attacks on-hit and damaging abilities apply stacks. The third stack deals bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health, and grants a burst of movement speed to Gnar.

blurb2.plain: Gnar will gain the movement speed upon transforming back to Mini Gnar.

description.plain: Passive: Gnar's basic attacks on-hit and ability hits apply a stack of Hyper to enemies for 3.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.

description2.plain: The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage, capped at 300 against monsters, and grant Gnar 20% / 40% / 60% / 80% (based on GNAR!'s rank) bonus movement speed that decays over 3 seconds.

description3.plain: Gnar gains Hyper's bonus movement speed when he leaves Mega form.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Gnar|Mini Gnar}} {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location and bounces off of any unit he lands on, {{tip|dash|leaping}} forth again without a bounce. He also gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for a few seconds.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gnar''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location, then gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 6 seconds.
params.description2: If '''Gnar''' lands on a unit he will {{tip|dash|bounce}} 500 units further in the same direction. Landing on an enemy deals them {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 80% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.description3: If ''Hop'' is used to transform, it will not grant {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}. Instead, after {{tip|dash|bouncing}} '''Gnar''' will send out a shockwave as per ''{{ai|Crunch|Gnar}}'' {{tt|where he lands|Only after bouncing. This is not intended. See details section.}}.

params.description5: ''{{ai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}} can be cast during the dash.''
